Name: 12ft Home Depot Skeleton for CP and AT
Author: jenf1
Description:
[size=4][b]Disclaimer:[/b] The original version of this mod, which you can find [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/18940]here[/url], has open permissions and therefore I have taken the liberty of converting it from DGA to Content Patcher and Alternative Textures. If/when the original author updates their mod, I shall be removing this one.[/size]

- Can be bought from Robin for 1500g.
- Doesn't glow. It kept glitching when I tried, so it's just regular decor instead.

- AT version is on Tree of the Winter Star. It glows. (Recommended you use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12629]One Tile High Tree[/url] with it)

[b][size=4]OUTFIT LIST[/size][/b] (copied and pasted from the original mod page)
[list]
[*]Naked/No outfit
[/list][list]
[*]Tuesday- Kind of clown outfit
[*]Friday- Todd outfit (I keep a skeleton in my car with a chicken hat, pink goggles, and yellow bow tie)
[*]Spring day 1- Grandpa Jammies (remember your roots)
[*]Egg Festival- Bunny ears and tutu
[*]Flower Dance- Pretty dress
[*]Summer day 3- Mayor Lewis's lucky purple shorts
[*]Luau- Pirate costume
[*]Summer day 24- Trans pride flag, my mod my rules
[*]Dance of the Moonlight Jellies- Jellyfish on head
[*]Stardew Valley Fair- Farmer getup
[*]Spirit's Eve- Pumpkin head and cool cape
[*]Festival of Ice- Snufkin costume (because there is fishing and he likes fishing? you get it)
[*]Feast of the Winter Star- Cozy sweater and earmuffs
[*]Winter day 28- Propeller hat and bow tie, happy new year I guess?
[*]Player's Wedding- Wedding dress
[/list]

Install:

- Download and install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url], and/or [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url].
- Copy [CP] Big Ol Skeleton and/or [AT] Big Ol Skeleton into your Stardew Valley/Mods folder
- Load the game using SMAPI and enjoy!

Credit goes to [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/GoblinHours/about-me?gameId=1303]GoblinHours[/url] for the original mod.
